symptom: A pluggable widget property the editor hides was unknown to mxcli whenever the widget's editorConfig.js hid it in a shape the static reader could not lift: check passed a non-default hidden value and exec wrote a hidden text template with its default text, both CE0463 (Image 1.5.0 `iconSize: 20` in imageUrl mode, mx check 11.16.1), and a widget with its own hide helper (ChessClock) had no rule at all. A guard on Studio's `target` was read as if it held in Studio Pro (TreeNode, Maps, charts), so Studio Pro-visible properties were treated as hidden.
cause: Hide rules were lifted from the bundle's source one JavaScript shape at a time (editorconfig_extract.go); 96 of 170 widget versions had hide calls it could not state, and `target` was never part of a rule.
file: modelsdk/widgets/editorconfig/editorconfig.go, mdl/executor/editorconfig_eval.go, mdl/executor/widget_engine.go, mdl/executor/validate_widgets.go, mdl/executor/validate_widget_required.go, mdl/executor/widget_describe.go, mdl/types/widget_visibility.go
fix: Run getProperties(values, defaultProperties, "desktop") in goja for the widget's actual values and replace the top-level lifted rules with always/never rules for that configuration (evaluatedVisibilityRules); lifted rules remain the fallback and the only source for object-list item properties.
insight: The spike that settled it was cheap: one Go program over every .mpk on the machine, calling getProperties with defaults and diffing against the lifted rules at the same defaults. It showed both kinds of miss in one table, and the static-only column (properties the reader called hidden that the function shows) was the surprise: all of it came from `target === "web"` branches. Pass the tree as real JS objects (JSON.parse inside the VM): a Go slice wrapped by goja does not survive the helpers' filter/splice, which is what 74 of the first 96 failures were. Regression guard: every TestApp (77) and PedApp (16) page rebuilt with create or replace stays byte-equal ('in sync'), and the 42 generated widget examples give the same CE0463 set as main.
test: modelsdk/widgets/editorconfig/editorconfig_test.go (own helper, desktop target, no getProperties, hostile bundles, cache); mdl/executor/editorconfig_eval_1776_test.go (check reports with a control that the reader lifted 0 rules, build nulls a hidden template with a shown control, rule merge, describe example); revert proof: evaluation disabled fails the check and build tests
